# Pearl Construction

> Pools, outdoor living & construction based in San Antonio, Texas. Pearl Construction builds custom pools, spas, water features and hardscape across North San Antonio, with clear communication and timelines it actually meets.

- Phone: (210) 371-0971
- Based in: San Antonio, TX
- Service area: San Antonio, Stone Oak, Shavano Park, Hollywood Park, Timberwood Park, Helotes
- Google rating: 5.0 from 17 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/pearl-construction/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/pearl-construction/book.html

## Services
- Custom pools & spas: Pools and raised spas designed around your yard, from shell to tile and coping.
- Water features: Sheer descents, stone water walls and laminar jets that bring the pool to life.
- Hardscape, pavers & turf: Pavers, stepping stones and artificial turf that tie the pool to the house.
- Pavilions, patios & sport courts: Shade structures, new flatwork and sport courts for the rest of the backyard.
- Residential construction: Home projects handled by the same team that builds the pool.
- Commercial build-outs: Shell and interior build-outs for commercial spaces in San Antonio.

## About
Pearl Construction works out of an office on Hardy Oak Blvd in Stone Oak, North San Antonio. The team builds custom pools and spas, water features, pavers and turf, pavilions and sport courts, and handles residential projects and commercial build-outs. All 17 of its Google reviews are five stars. One homeowner came to Pearl after trying several other construction companies and says the difference was night and day: clear communication, realistic timelines that were met, and a finished project they are proud of.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you build pools in Stone Oak and North San Antonio?
  A: Yes. Pearl's office is on Hardy Oak Blvd in Stone Oak, and the team builds across North San Antonio, Shavano Park, Hollywood Park, Timberwood Park and Helotes.
- Q: Can you add a spa or water feature?
  A: Yes. Raised and attached spas, sheer water walls, stone features and laminar jets are all part of Pearl's pool work.
- Q: Do you do the hardscape around the pool too?
  A: Yes. Pavers, turf, patios, pavilions and sport courts can be built with the pool or on their own.
- Q: How long will my pool take?
  A: It depends on size, finishes and permits. You get a realistic timeline up front, and reviewers say Pearl meets it.
- Q: Do you take on commercial work?
  A: Yes. Pearl handles commercial build-outs in San Antonio as well as residential projects.
- Q: When is the office open?
  A: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, at 18911 Hardy Oak Blvd, Suite 206. The office is wheelchair accessible.
